latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Implements correct Lazy Load strategy selection and planning for persistence layers to avoid N+1 queries and related pitfalls.

- Identifies data-source pattern and ORM/framework in use.
- Classifies associations for appropriate lazy/eager loading strategies.
- Detects and addresses ripple loading and proxy identity traps.
- Selects the best Lazy Load variant with trade-off analysis.
- Produces a tailored implementation plan including batch loading, eager-load overrides, Identity Map integration, and a ripple-loading audit.
- Applicable to major ORMs (Hibernate, SQLAlchemy, Django, EF Core, TypeORM, Rails) and hand-rolled mappers.
